diagram_math_checks.evidence: Each panel has exactly three transported strands at positions qi, qi+1, qi+2. Tracing W0 bottom-to-top gives label position orders (i,i+1,i+2), (i+1,i,i+2), (i+1,i+2,i), (i+2,i+1,i); W1 gives (i,i+1,i+2), (i,i+2,i+1), (i+2,i,i+1), (i+2,i+1,i). Both realize the transposition (i i+2) of proof step 1.1.

Figure heights 0,1,2,4 represent u=0,1/4,1/2,1. W0 has bottom-to-top generators sigma_i,sigma_i+1,sigma_i and W1 sigma_i+1,sigma_i,sigma_i+1, precisely the rightmost-first bracketings from F4 and step 1.1. No reversal of stacking is asserted.

At each local generator midpoint F2 and the half-twist definition give left-starting motion m+rho with transverse coordinate -h, right-starting m-rho with +h. Caption fixes viewing from positive transverse coordinate. All six rising-left-to-right segments are gapped behind continuous rising-right-to-left segments, so each is the defined positive generator.

The horizontal component rho_1=2hv-h gives the straight crossing segments. At both phase boundaries all three positions join correctly; each panel has only three intentional underpass gaps and no unintended missing pieces. There are no closures in this open braid picture. The sim relation is exactly step 5.1, established using the independent isotopies of steps 3.1 and 4.1; no new isotopy construction is inferred from the image.
